questions.question_text: What did the customer order?
How long ago did the package leave the warehouse?
When should the package arrive?
What did the agent promise to do if the package is late?
options: Do nothing, the customer must wait

questions.question_text: What time does breakfast start?
When does the pool close?
What should the guest do to request a late check-out?
options: Just leave later without telling anyone
Pay an automatic extra fee on the bill
Ask at the front desk the night before

questions.question_text: What does the receptionist recommend for valuables?

audios.title: Shift handover at a call center

questions.question_text: What is the speaker most concerned about?
options: The customer has been unusually demanding today
The ticket was never actually opened
The billing issue might not be fixed

questions.question_text: Why does he doubt the ticket was properly resolved?
options: Only the first of two charges was checked
The ticket was closed without any review
The customer had complained too many times

questions.question_text: What does he suggest before calling the customer back?
options: Cancel the callback appointment altogether for now
Wait until someone re-checks both charges
Tell her it's fixed right away

questions.question_text: Which best describes his attitude?
options: Confident: the problem is completely settled
Alarmed: the customer might complain publicly online
Cautious: the issue may still be unresolved

questions.question_text: What is her overall position on using these tools?
options: She supports the tools but distrusts how they're relied on
She is firmly opposed to using them at all
She believes vendors deliberately fake their published figures

questions.question_text: Why does she doubt the published accuracy figures?
options: They were deliberately manipulated by the vendors
They're based on tidy data, not real messy applications
They always perform worse than a human reviewer

questions.question_text: What does she mean by "a quieter problem"?
options: The system always gives a clear error message
Rejected candidates are always told the exact reason
Strong candidates can be rejected without anyone noticing

questions.question_text: What does she want before trusting the system at scale?
options: Real performance data and a right to challenge results
More marketing demonstrations arranged by the vendors themselves
Nothing more, since she completely trusts the system already
